overview.description: Capital efficiency is not frugality. It is the ratio of what you learned to what you spent, and expensive validation is the most common way to get it badly wrong.
objectives: Measure spend against assumptions retired, not against runway consumed
Recognise the experiment that costs ten times more and proves the same thing
Spend on the things investors actually reward
prerequisites: Technical risk, market risk and the risk map

steps.intro: Capital efficiency is not frugality. It is the ratio of what you learned to what you spent, and expensive validation is the most common way to get it badly wrong.
instructions: Take last month’s spend and assign every line to an assumption it tested.
Anything that tested nothing is either infrastructure or waste. Decide which.
Design next month so the largest line item retires the largest risk.
